Good afternoon, welcome to the Hotel Spree. How can I help you?
Hi. My name is Camillo Furlan. Can I check in now?
I'm sorry, Mr. Furlan. You can't check in before three. Your room isn't ready.
No problem. Can you keep my bag, please?
Of course. And at three, your room key is here at the front desk.
Great. What time is breakfast?
From six thirty to ten, on the first floor. The elevator is on the left.
And can I check out late on Sunday?
Yes, you can. Check-out is at eleven, but you can stay until one. Enjoy Berlin!

Welcome to the Hotel Spree in Berlin. Check-in is from three p.m., and check-out is at eleven a.m. Breakfast is from six thirty to ten, on the first floor. You can use the gym from six a.m. to ten p.m. You can't smoke in the rooms. If you need help, you can call the front desk at any time. Enjoy your stay!

Hi, I'm Lucas, from Brazil. I travel a lot for work. In a hotel, I always ask three things. Can I check in early? Can I have a quiet room? I can't sleep with noise. And what is the Wi-Fi password? In Germany, the people at the front desk can speak English very well, so it is easy. My English is not perfect, but I can say what I need.

Camillo arrives at a hotel in Berlin at noon. He goes to the front desk. He asks: Can I check in now? The receptionist says: I'm sorry, you can't. Check-in is at three. He leaves his bag at the hotel and goes for a walk. At three o'clock, he gets his room key and goes up in the elevator.
